newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish July trade surplus FIM 3.17 billion -NCB.
newsitem.headline: Finnish July trade surplus FIM 3.17 billion -NCB.

text.p: Finland's trade surplus fell to 3.17 billion markka in July from 5.82 billion in June, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement on Tuesday.
The value of exports rose nine percent year-on-year in July while the value of imports rose one percent, NCB said.
The Bank of Finland earlier estimated the July trade surplus at 3.8 billion markka with exports estimated at 13.4 billion and imports at 9.6 billion.
The NCB's official monthly trade statistics are lagging behind due to changes in customs procedures when Finland joined the European Union at the start of 1995.
